scope: Independent static cross-review of bulk fixture equivalence; not runtime performance acceptance or final release acceptance.

tests.summary: Read-only final source/diff review; no heavy execution. Parent owns final single-deadline release-gate execution. Earlier reported 18.59s scoped PASS used the now-reverted split fixture phases and is not claimed as final-source runtime acceptance.

checks.counts: VIDEO_COUNT remains 320000; SOURCE_COUNT remains 100; 32 batches each generate exactly 10000 rows in the same single transaction.
checks.integer_binding: Recursive seed CAST(@start AS INTEGER) fixes JS number bound as REAL producing IDs with .0. i + 1 remains INTEGER; exact integer-valued @end comparison gives original half-open [start,end) range.
checks.source_mapping: sources are still produced by original repo.addSourceFolder calls in array ordinal order. TEMP mapping uses that ordinal and i % 100, matching sources[index % SOURCE_COUNT]. No UUID sorting or source-grouped insertion.
checks.insertion_order: ORDER BY i ASC is on the final INSERT SELECT, not merely the number CTE. Batches run start=0,10000,...,310000. Fresh production videos table is empty, so rowid=i+1 as in the original loop.
checks.metadata_failure_distribution: Unchanged UPDATE marks rowid divisible by 4 as failed: i % 4 = 3 gives 80000 failed and 240000 pending. Existing failureIndex*64+3 always has rowid divisible by 4; 5000 failure records retain exact original IDs, source IDs, paths and lowercased normalized paths.
checks.schema_and_pragmas: Original createDatabase, full current migrations, WAL and foreign_keys remain. No production table/index/trigger changes, no trigger mask suppression, no ANALYZE/cache/synchronous override, no INSERT OR IGNORE/REPLACE. Only owned TEMP map is created/dropped.
checks.budget_current_fixture: Final source has no beforeAll hook or separate setup deadline. Production database creation, all 320000 fixture rows, strengthened invariant assertions, all page/directory/metadata queries, metadata UPDATE and 5000 failure inserts are inside the original single it with 60000ms overall deadline. Source query <2000ms; directory query <3000ms; metadata query <3000ms. Existing statement-count assertions and measured query bodies remain unchanged.
checks.strengthened_invariants: Each INSERT changes=10000; total COUNT=320000; ID equals asset-video-(rowid-1); 100 source groups each count=3200; all/library/images revisions increment exactly 320000 and batch_mask unchanged. Initial REAL seed mismatch was caught, not waived.

all_inserted_fields.equivalence: asset-video- concatenated INTEGER i equals original JS index string.
TEMP mapping id for ordinal i%100 equals sources[index%100].id.
directory || char(92) || filename equals original Windows separator path.
Original source.path plus backslash bucket- plus CAST(i/10000 AS INTEGER) equals Math.floor(index/10000), since all indices are nonnegative integers.
printf video-%06d.mp4 equals String(index).padStart(6,0) for the fixed range 0..319999.
10000+i equals original 10000+index; stored integer values identical.
1000+i*1000 equals original 1000+index*1000; exact within JS safe integer range.
Original ready before unchanged later rowid-based UPDATE.

checks.omitted_columns: INSERT column list remains identical, so all omitted codec/provider/duration-source columns use the same current production defaults.

risks: Static equivalence does not prove setup completes in 60s or final integrated release gates pass; parent must record actual scoped/full results.

New invariant scans can affect SQLite page-cache state, but the measured page/directory/metadata queries are not called for warm-up and budgets remain unchanged. This gate is not explicitly a cold-cache benchmark.
Numbers and expressions are reviewed for fixed 320000/100 constants. Changing data scale or source count requires updating modulo/batch generation and equivalence checks together.
